steps.cap: Data centers are where AI chips go to work. A large training site holds a hundred thousand of them, in rows of racks.
Power comes in from the grid, stepped down by a substation, and runs through the data center to every rack. One rack of AI chips draws up to 142 kilowatts.
Every watt of it comes back out as heat, more than air can carry away.

So water runs through plates on the chips, carries the heat to coolers outdoors and comes back. Racks are heading for a megawatt each by 2027, so the power coming in and the heat going out keep growing.
